blinding_guess.why: Weak guess: the outbound stream's type switch (DISTANCE_SENSOR.hpp:73-89) has cases for ULTRASOUND, LASER and INFRARED only, so a sensor whose uORB type is MAV_DISTANCE_SENSOR_RADAR (defined in msg/distance_sensor.msg:17) is sent as LASER by the default branch; distances are float metres scaled by 1e2f into the MAVLink fields without clamping.

notes: PX4 provides DISTANCE_SENSOR as an outbound MAVLink stream: class MavlinkStreamDistanceSensor in src/modules/mavlink/streams/DISTANCE_SENSOR.hpp (registered at src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_messages.cpp:480-482) fills time_boot_ms (line 71, us to ms), type (73-89), current_distance (91, m to cm), id (92, set to the uORB subscription index i), max_distance (93, m to cm), min_distance (94, m to cm), orientation (95, copied from uORB) and covariance (96), then calls mavlink_msg_distance_sensor_send_struct (98). The message definition itself is not in the snapshot: it is generated by mavgen from message_definitions/v1.0/${MAVLINK_DIALECT}.xml with MAVLINK_DIALECT "development" ("standard" on flash-constrained boards) (src/modules/mavlink/CMakeLists.txt:34-60), inside the git submodule src/modules/mavlink/mavlink, which is an empty directory in this snapshot (.gitmodules lists it as https://github.com/mavlink/mavlink.git). The XML is not an allowed dependency file type (.msg/.srv/.action/.idl) and ros_distro is null, so it was not fetched. Consequently: no definition_id could be computed for any port; the field types required by the 'field <pkg/Type>.<field>: <fieldtype>' template and the hash required by 'msg <pkg/Type>: <hash>' are undeterminable, so all eight packet elements are in neither declares nor not_declared (the code clearly produces all seven fields, so not_declared would be wrong; their declared types could not be read). msg_type common/DISTANCE_SENSOR follows the packet's parent name; the code names the message only as DISTANCE_SENSOR (MAVLINK_MSG_ID_DISTANCE_SENSOR, mavlink_distance_sensor_t), so the dialect file that defines it was not verified. The uORB message msg/distance_sensor.msg (px4 package, metres, float32) is a different type and was not used for field types. Units are from the conversion comments in the stream code. Frames: no frame name is declared or hard-coded for the distance fields or orientation (orientation is an enum copied per sample from the uORB topic), so null; id, type and time_boot_ms have no spatial meaning. QoS is null (MAVLink, ROS 1 generation). rate_hz is null because the stream rate is set per MAVLink mode rather than once: 0.5 Hz in MAVLINK_MODE_NORMAL (mavlink_main.cpp:1494), 10 Hz in ONBOARD (1544), EXTVISION/EXTVISIONMIN (1615), CONFIG (1690) and ONBOARD_LOW_BANDWIDTH (1776), and 50 Hz via 'mavlink stream -r 50 -s DISTANCE_SENSOR' in ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/airframes/1010_iris_opt_flow.post:3. References list the inbound side: PX4 also decodes received DISTANCE_SENSOR messages in mavlink_receiver.cpp:922-954 and simulator_mavlink.cpp:380-383,1413-1469 (reading id, min/max/current_distance, covariance, fov, quaternion, type, orientation, signal_quality; time_boot_ms is not read, system time is used). No permission, recovery, or exclusive-resource declarations exist in the stream code or its registration.
